records.source: Oh, hey. So you're the new guy, huh? Cool.^Hey, you're the new girl, huh? I think we're going to get along great. I'm Alex.#$e#I'll see you around.
records.translation: 喔，嘿。所以你就是新來的傢伙，對吧？酷。^嘿，你就是新來的女生，對吧？我覺得我們會很合得來。我是亞歷克斯。#$e#回頭見。

records.source: You beat me to it! I was about to ask you...$h#$e#I'll see you out there.
records.translation: 被你搶先了！我正要邀請你……$h#$e#舞會上見。

records.source: Aw yeah, that's the good stuff... Thanks for the birthday gift, @.
records.translation: 太棒了，就是這種好東西……謝謝你的生日禮物，@。

records.source: What the...? Uh, I dunno what it's like where you grew up, but to me, this is trash.$a
records.translation: 這什麼……？呃，我不知道你長大的地方是怎樣，但在我看來，這就是垃圾。$a

records.source: Whoa... this is great. Thanks!
records.translation: 哇……這真棒。謝啦！

records.source: Aw, yeah... I've been looking for this one. It's supposed to be full of tips for bulking up. Rule number one... Eat a ton of eggs! Hah, no problem! Thanks!$h
records.translation: 太棒了……我一直在找這本書。據說裡面全是增肌技巧。第一條……吃一大堆蛋！哈，沒問題！謝啦！$h

records.source: Uhhh... Reading? Yeah, um... I guess I can give it a try.$s
records.translation: 呃……看書？好吧，嗯……我想可以試試。$s

records.source: Umm... I know I'm pretty big on eggs... But this isn't what I meant...$s#$b#Oh well... Down the hatch! *gulp*$h
records.translation: 嗯……我知道自己很愛吃蛋……但我不是指這種……$s#$b#算了……吞下去吧！*咕嚕*$h

records.source: Can you eat this?$s#$b#I guess there's only one way to find out...
records.translation: 這個能吃嗎？$s#$b#看來只有一種方法能知道……

records.source: Hehe... Keep giving me these every day, and I'll be able to retire at thirty!$h
records.translation: 嘿嘿……每天都送我這個，我三十歲就能退休了！$h

records.source: Now that's what I call an egg! Imagine the size of the omelet...
records.translation: 這才叫蛋嘛！想像一下能煎出多大的歐姆蛋……

records.source: Whoaa... It's so heavy I could use it for bicep curls. I'll be slurping on this for a week! Hah hah!$h
records.translation: 哇啊……重得都能拿來做二頭肌彎舉了。這夠我吸上一整個星期！哈哈！$h

records.source: Mmm... Duck egg... Rich and creamy. *crack*... *slurp*. Ahhhh...
records.translation: 嗯……鴨蛋……濃郁滑順。*敲裂*……*吸溜*。啊……

records.source: Oh... um... I usually like eggs, but this one looks evil.$s
records.translation: 喔……嗯……我通常很喜歡蛋，但這顆看起來很邪惡。$s

records.source: *crunch*... Mmm... Nuts. That hits the spot. Thanks, @!
records.translation: *嘎吱*……嗯……堅果。正合我意。謝啦，@！

records.source: $c 0.8#Hey, thanks. Eggs are great for bulking up.#*crack*... *sluuurp*... Mmmm. Now that's what I call a snack.
records.translation: $c 0.8#嘿，謝啦。蛋很適合增肌。#*敲裂*……*吸溜*……嗯。這才叫點心。

records.source: Have you been up by the lake recently? I was on a run late last night, and I noticed that the old bridge was repaired...
records.translation: 你最近去過湖邊嗎？昨晚很晚的時候，我跑步經過那裡，發現那座舊橋修好了……

records.source: Uh... I'm not used to opening up like that...$s
records.translation: 呃……我不習慣那樣敞開心扉……$s

records.source: Heard you caught some kind of rare fish?#$b#I'm impressed. Your arms must be stronger than they look! *pinch* ... not bad!$h
records.translation: 聽說你釣到某種稀有魚？#$b#真令人佩服。你的手臂一定比看起來更有力！*捏*……不錯嘛！$h

records.source: Hey, I overheard someone saying that you got your first chicken the other day.#$b#Man... I wish Grandma had chickens. I'd eat a dozen raw eggs for breakfast each morning!
records.translation: 嘿，我無意間聽到有人說，你前幾天養了第一隻雞。#$b#天啊……真希望奶奶也養雞。那樣我每天早餐都能吃上一打生蛋！

records.source: Hey... uh... @? I... feel a lot more 'at peace' after talking to you on the beach last week.$s#$b#Thanks for listening to me.$s
records.translation: 嘿……呃……@？上週在海灘和你聊過後，我……感覺「平靜」多了。$s#$b#謝謝你聽我說。$s

records.source: I saw you catch that salmon.#$b#If you happen to make a 'salmon dinner' out of it, let me have a bite!
records.translation: 我看到你釣到那條鮭魚了。#$b#如果你碰巧拿它做成「鮭魚晚餐」，記得讓我吃一口！

records.source: I saw you checking out the bath house the other day. Trying to get in shape? Heh.#$e#Uh... you didn't go poking around in my locker, did you?$9
records.translation: 前幾天我看到你去澡堂了。想鍛鍊身材？嘿。#$e#呃……你沒有亂翻我的置物櫃吧？$9

records.source: What's going on out there? Any action?#$e#I gotta stay here with my grandparents...$s
records.translation: 外面發生什麼事了？有什麼刺激的嗎？#$e#我得留在這裡陪祖父母……$s

records.source: I tried to go for a run this morning, but the plants have gone crazy! I couldn't get very far...
records.translation: 今天早上我想去跑步，但那些植物全都瘋長！根本走不了多遠……

records.source: %Alex gives your arm a squeeze, grinning.
records.translation: %Alex咧嘴笑著捏了捏你的手臂。

records.source: Well, this is a %season I'll never forget!$l
records.translation: 嗯，這會是我永遠忘不了的%season！$l

records.source: You got Haley to marry you, huh? I always figured she was out of your league!
records.translation: 你居然讓海莉答應嫁給你，對吧？我一直覺得她是你高攀不起的類型！

records.source: Finally, we're here!
records.translation: 終於到了！

records.source: Aw... I guess it can't last forever.$s
records.translation: 唉……看來快樂時光不可能永遠持續。$s

records.source: I knew I shoulda brought a frisbee... Oh well.$h
records.translation: 早知道就該帶飛盤……算了。$h

records.source: I wonder if anyone would be up for a volleyball tournament.#$e#Don't worry, I'll go easy!$h
records.translation: 不知道有沒有人想參加排球錦標賽。#$e#別擔心，我會手下留情！$h

records.source: I wonder how far I could swim out, and still make it back?#$e#I'm guessing at least a mile.#$b#... Don't worry, I'm not going to try it.$h
records.translation: 不知道我能游出去多遠，還有力氣游回來？#$e#我猜至少一英里。#$b#……別擔心，我不會真的去試。$h

records.source: Aren't you hot in that outfit? C'mon, man... It's the beach!^Aren't you hot in that outfit? You gotta get some ocean breeze goin'!
records.translation: 你穿那身衣服不熱嗎？拜託，老兄……這裡可是海灘！^你穿那身衣服不熱嗎？得讓海風吹一吹啊！

records.source: With this island open, there's no excuse to be pasty anymore!
records.translation: 既然這座島開放了，就再也沒有理由白得像張紙！

records.source: Phew, it feels good to finally get these abs a little sunlight.#$e#Kind of a shame to have them hidden away all the time back home.
records.translation: 呼，終於能讓這身腹肌曬點陽光，感覺真好。#$e#平常在家裡總是把它們藏著，實在有點可惜。

records.source: When I go pro, I'll vacation on islands all around the world.#$e#But for now, this place will do just fine!$h
records.translation: 等我成為職業選手，就要去世界各地的島嶼度假。#$e#不過現在，這裡就很不錯了！$h

records.source: I'm ordering a banana shake with two scoops of protein powder.
records.translation: 我要點一杯香蕉奶昔，再加兩匙蛋白粉。

records.source: Ah... The island life. I could get used to this!
records.translation: 啊……島嶼生活。我可以習慣這種日子！

records.source: Okay, this should be fun... I hope I can remember the moves this year! It's been a while...$h
records.translation: 好，應該會很好玩……希望今年還記得那些舞步！畢竟有一陣子沒跳了……$h

records.source: Nah... I'm gonna ask someone else. Good luck.
records.translation: 不了……我要去邀請別人。祝你好運。

records.source: I thought we had something special... I guess I was wrong.$s
records.translation: 我以為我們之間很特別……看來我錯了。$s

records.source: You're not worth my time.$a
records.translation: 你不值得我浪費時間。$a

records.source: I don't know if I can trust you anymore, but I'm willing to give you a chance.$9
records.translation: 我不知道還能不能相信你，但願意給你一次機會。$9

records.source: You're giving me wha...?$7#$b#*huff*... Got it. Alright... well, you've made your choice. You're not gonna see me begging.$a
records.translation: 你要給我什……？$7#$b#*喘氣*……懂了。好吧……你已經做出選擇了。別指望我會求你。$a

records.source: Did you know I was an all-star quarterback in high school? It's true.$u#$e#See this little star on my jacket here? That proves it.
records.translation: 你知道我高中時是全明星四分衛嗎？是真的。$u#$e#看到外套上的這顆小星星了嗎？那就是證明。

records.source: The beach is a cool place to hang out and soak up some rays.#$e#You gotta spend some time in the sun or else you'll get all pale.#$e#*sigh*... I wish there were more girls in this town, know what I mean?$s^Hey, do you wanna hang out with me at the beach some time? Do you have a bikini?
records.translation: 海灘是個曬太陽、打發時間的好地方。#$e#你得花點時間曬太陽，不然會變得一臉蒼白。#$e#*嘆氣*……真希望鎮上有更多女生，你懂吧？$s^嘿，哪天想和我一起去海灘嗎？你有比基尼嗎？

records.source: Looks like a good day to play catch, huh?$u#$e#$q 5/6 Wed_01_old#I'd ask you to throw the ball around, but you don't really seem like the sports type.^If you weren't a girl I'd ask you to play catch.#$r 6 0 Wed_01_02#I'm fine just watching you from a distance.#$r 5 15 Wed_01_01#I want to play catch with you!#$r 5 0 Wed_01_03#(angry) What's that supposed to mean?
records.translation: 看來今天很適合玩傳接球，對吧？$u#$e#$q 5/6 Wed_01_old#我本來會找你一起傳球，但你看起來不太像愛運動的類型。^如果你不是女生，我就會找你玩傳接球。#$r 6 0 Wed_01_02#我在遠處看你就好。#$r 5 15 Wed_01_01#我想和你玩傳接球！#$r 5 0 Wed_01_03#（生氣）這話是什麼意思？

records.source: #$p 5#Go long! ...just kidding. Hahaha.|I just wish I had someone to play catch with...$s
records.translation: #$p 5#跑遠點！……開玩笑的。哈哈哈。|真希望有人能陪我玩傳接球……$s

records.source: Really? I guess I underestimated you.#$b#My arm's a little sore, but maybe next time.
records.translation: 真的嗎？看來我低估你了。#$b#我的手臂有點痠，也許下次吧。

records.source: Yeah, some people just aren't made for sports.
records.translation: 是啊，有些人天生就不適合運動。

records.source: Uh... never mind.
records.translation: 呃……算了。

records.source: The air's starting to warm up... I'm feeling pumped.
records.translation: 空氣開始暖起來了……我渾身充滿幹勁。

records.source: Hey, what's up farmer guy?^Hey, it's farm girl. Did you get new pants? You're doing something right.#$e#Oh, I almost forgot! It's my day for doing push-ups!#$e#Every time I do push-ups I try to do one more than last time. Pretty cool strategy, huh?
records.translation: 嘿，農夫老兄，最近如何？^嘿，是農場女孩。你換新褲子了嗎？看起來很不錯。#$e#喔，差點忘了！今天輪到做伏地挺身！#$e#每次做伏地挺身，我都會試著比上次多做一個。這策略很酷，對吧？

records.source: My arms are really sore, but that's the sign of progress for a guy like me.#$e#I must've done a thousand push-ups yesterday.
records.translation: 我的手臂真的很痠，但對我這種人來說，這正是進步的證明。#$e#我昨天肯定做了一千個伏地挺身。

records.source: Hey.#$e#What, you wanna talk to me? I'm busy.
records.translation: 嘿。#$e#怎樣，想和我說話？我很忙。

records.source: Hey, @.#$e#That's right, I remember your name.
records.translation: 嘿，@。#$e#沒錯，我記得你的名字。

records.source: Hey, @.#$e#How's your day going?
records.translation: 嘿，@。#$e#今天過得如何？

records.source: Hey, @. I'm glad you stopped by.#$e#I'm not ashamed to say that I love my grandma!#$e#Now Grandpa, on the other hand...#$e#Just kidding.$h
records.translation: 嘿，@。很高興你來看我。#$e#我不怕承認自己愛奶奶！#$e#至於爺爺嘛……#$e#開玩笑的。$h

records.source: Nothing's better than an energetic day at the beach with your friends... right?
records.translation: 沒有什麼比和朋友在海灘上活力十足地玩一天更棒……對吧？

records.source: You know, I used to want fame and fortune, but lately I've been starting to sing a different tune. In the end it's the humble little things that satisfy, don't you think?#$e#I still want to go pro, but it's not the most important thing in the world.
records.translation: 你知道嗎，我以前渴望名聲和財富，但最近開始改變想法了。到頭來，真正令人滿足的是那些平凡的小事，你不覺得嗎？#$e#我還是想成為職業選手，但那已經不是世上最重要的事。

records.source: Hi @. You look sporty today.$h^Hey @. Did you do something different with your hair? Something keeps grabbing my attention.$h
records.translation: 嗨，@。你今天看起來很有運動氣息。$h^嘿，@。你的髮型有什麼不一樣嗎？總有什麼吸引著我的目光。$h
